[FMLA 21] Bernoulli — Bernoulli's Theorem

Incompressible steady flow. The calculator prints C = v²/2 + gz + P/ρ (energy per unit mass), not the pressure-form constant.

Calculator scroll name: Bernoulli. For steady inviscid incompressible flow, height, speed, and pressure trade off. The ROM evaluates the energy-per-mass constant C, not the pressure-form sum P + ρgh + ½ρv².

formula
C=2v2​+gz+ρP​

For a steady incompressible flow, height, speed, and pressure trade off. Low and narrow → fast and lower P.

Multiply through by density ρ to recover the textbook pressure form P + ρgz + ½ρv² (same physics; a different number on the display).

keys
FMLA→2→1

Primary inputs: v, z, ρ, P (that prompt order; height is z, not h).

steps

How to run

  1. Press FMLA, then 2, then 1 (or scroll to the name and EXE)
  2. Enter each prompted value
  3. Read C (energy per unit mass)

Example

  1. FMLA → 2 → 1
  2. Enter v, z, ρ, P
  3. Display is C = v²/2 + gz + P/ρ, not P + ρgz + ½ρv²
note

The routine uses gravitational acceleration g from ROM. Keep v, z, ρ, and P in consistent SI units (m/s, m, kg/m³, Pa).
